name: cart-issues
title: Cart issues
description: The problems in a cart that need fixing before checkout: unavailable lines, price changes and minimums, each with its one fix.
docs: Remove an issue from the list when you have fixed it or the shopper has dismissed it, and keep the component mounted when the list is empty: focus moves to the next action, or to the status line when the last one is gone. Everything blocks except a price change, unless you set blocking. Point your checkout button's aria-describedby at the region's id, or print summarizeCartIssues(issues).reason (from cart-issues/issues, which also runs on the server) next to it. onBlockingChange reports the change.
